description: Public-safe reliability cases for comparing the same model and task conditions with different agent runtimes.

cases.objective: Reject a tool call that omits a required argument before execution.
Detect an argument with the wrong primitive type before execution.
Reject an argument value outside the allowed enum.
Recover from one simple deterministic argument error within a bounded retry budget.
Avoid silently repairing an ambiguous semantic error.
Detect that a required artifact is missing before declaring success.
Invalidate earlier evidence after a later change makes it stale.
Avoid reporting task completion when required verification has not passed.
Stop or escalate repeated no-progress actions instead of looping indefinitely.
Require an explicit policy decision before a high-risk action proceeds.
Detect a tool result that does not satisfy the expected success contract.
Report completion only when required evidence is present and current.
